name: Victoria

routes.outcome: Capital Regional District Properties MapServer. Service description says it contains transportation, water, property and administrative boundaries; layer 2 is Lot Boundaries 2.5K-7.5K.

Layer 2 is a polygon Feature Layer described as geometry and attribution for properties within CRD. Spatial reference is EPSG:26910 / NAD 1983 UTM Zone 10N. Safe identity candidates include GISLink and PID; metadata also exposes other source fields that were not requested or retained.

Provincial ParcelMap BC Parcel Polygons layer is a polygon Feature Layer in EPSG:3005 / BC Albers and advertises JSON/GeoJSON query formats. Metadata identifies PID, PARCEL_NAME, PLAN_NUMBER and PMBC_PP_SYSID fields; no feature response was retained.
